goal: Audit existing Starlane Home captures and packaged widget artwork for missing, blank, misleading, or fragile provider/network card imagery.
success_criteria: Inspect only relevant existing screenshots/captures and the exact Home widget artwork/fallback definitions.
Identify each observed or source-proven missing-art class and separate provider-data absence from renderer or cache faults.
Recommend a bounded fallback hierarchy and Show more card treatment consistent with the brand and D-pad focus rules.
Return exact evidence paths and implementation guidance without editing assets or source.
primary_hypothesis: Some apparent missing provider/network cards are remote-art or directory-data gaps rather than Home renderer faults, so a local fallback hierarchy and explicit terminal-card art will stabilize presentation.
discriminating_check: Compare visible blank/missing cards in the newest relevant captures with the texture expressions and available packaged fallbacks for the same row type.
stop_conditions: No relevant capture exists and the finding cannot be established from source.
The audit would require new device capture or image generation.
